source: DXRP portal Servers page for LifePunch

servers.purpose: Test LifePunch addons, gamemode changes, and newer beta features before public release.
servers.addonPolicy: Custom LifePunch addons and experimental DXRP features are tested here first.

servers.purpose: 70-player DXRP server — public s&box 26.06.24, Dev-promoted portal addon pins (June 2026).
servers.addonPolicy: Do not deploy custom addon or beta feature changes here until they are proven safe and compatible with official DXRP limitations.

notes: The DXRP Servers page should be treated as a two-server operational surface for LifePunch.
70p may run Vanilla until LIFEPUNCH™ ship gamemode is assigned after bitcoin publish-ready sign-off.
Development server tests LIFEPUNCH™ gamemode pins before 70p promotion.
Do not design workflows around unmanaged or external servers unless the owner adds them later.

lifepunchnet: Official C:\SBOX-DXRP-Server (27015/27018) public 26.06.24; Dev Steam sbox (27016/27017) staging. Layout: LIFEPUNCHNET_HOST_LAYOUT.md; deploy: dxrp-host/scripts/Deploy-DxrpHostLaunchers.ps1.
Engine: Official public 26.06.24 pinned on-box (buildid 23900007) — avoid auto_update_official.bat unless testing staging. Dev: auto_update.bat or auto_update_all.bat.
Portal pins (June 2026): kevlar r16, base r6, ulx r10, monnow r2 — promote on dxrp.net; Dev first.
Internal server ids are lifepunchdevelopment and lifepunchmainserver.
Development and 70p procedures must remain separate.
